commit.message: Set pretouch range array size to number of locality groups
Updated as per the suggested changes.

JDK-8396962: Parallelize NUMA pretouch of ParallelGC eden at initial setup

With -XX:+UseNUMA and -XX:+AlwaysPreTouch, ParallelGC pretouches the eden
range of each NUMA node with PretouchTask, one node after another.

On the initial eden setup, NUMAPretouchTask touches all the NUMA pages in
one task. A local worker first touches its own region and then helps the node
with the most bytes left. Resize still uses PretouchTask.
